changes.summary: Retained-power window after ignition off extends from 45 s to 60 s (front-door-open exit unchanged). This now absorbs the deleted duplicate WLC-023.
Trigger changed from rain sensor to the CAN request WLC_CloseAll. The vague 'quickly' is replaced by express mode with anti-pinch active. The rain trigger is no longer specified.
Pinch detection threshold lowered from 100 N to 80 N, so detection is more sensitive.
Minimum reversal distance increased from 125 mm to 150 mm. The 10 ms stop time and the 'or fully open' limit are unchanged.
Wording only ('set itself to' became 'set its state to'). The 500 ms limit and the not-normalized result are the same.
The vague 'limit' and 'safe value' are replaced by numbers: the temperature threshold is 130 °C and the current is limited to 15 A.
WLC_Status period is halved from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms. The content (four signals) is unchanged.
Narrowed to storing B1A02 (above 25 A for more than 50 ms). The motor-stop and fault-state reactions moved to the new WLC-037 and WLC-038.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Unchanged: mean current below 100 µA, provided WLC-004 states this limit.
tests.reason: Remove the trace to deleted WLC-032 and keep the test under WLC-004, because sleep current is still a real requirement. Confirm that WLC-004 carries the 100 µA limit.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Movement at 55 s after ignition off; no movement at 65 s; no movement after a front door is opened at 10 s. Remove the trace to deleted WLC-023.
tests.reason: The window grows from 45 s to 60 s, so the 40 s and 50 s sample points no longer straddle the limit. The new points sit either side of 60 s, and the WLC-023 trace goes.

tests.new_pass_criteria: With the window half open, send the CAN request WLC_CloseAll. The window closes fully in express mode (no further switch input). With the pinch rod in the closing path, the anti-pinch function is active and detects a pinch per WLC-014 (above 80 N) and reverses.
tests.reason: The trigger is now a CAN request instead of a rain signal, and anti-pinch must be active during the close, so both the procedure and the criteria change.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm, or to fully open if that is less.
tests.reason: The threshold changes to 80 N and the reversal distance to 150 mm. Check that the rod at 100 mm still allows 150 mm of reversal or full open.

tests.new_pass_criteria: At 9.0 V: motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm, or to fully open if that is less.
tests.reason: It inherits the new 80 N and 150 mm limits from TC-AP-01, so it must be updated and rerun.

tests.new_pass_criteria: At 16.0 V: motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm, or to fully open if that is less.
tests.reason: It inherits the new 80 N and 150 mm limits from TC-AP-01, so it must be updated and rerun.

tests.new_pass_criteria: At 9.0 V and -30 °C: motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm, or to fully open if that is less.
tests.reason: It inherits the new limits. This is the cold, low-voltage worst-case corner, so run it first and on every software release.

tests.new_pass_criteria: At 13.5 V and 85 °C: motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm, or to fully open if that is less.
tests.reason: It inherits the new 80 N and 150 mm limits from TC-AP-01, so it must be updated and rerun.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Keep the pass criteria: no false pinch detection on the rough-road vibration profile, now at the 80 N threshold. Retrace to WLC-014.
tests.reason: Remove the trace to deleted WLC-018. The test is still needed, because a lower threshold raises the risk of false reversals (LL-2021-07), so retrace it to WLC-014 and rerun it.
The WLC-021 change is wording only; the 500 ms limit and the result are unchanged.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Once the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, motor current is limited to 15 A. Below 130 °C no limiting is applied.
tests.reason: The requirement now has numeric limits, so the vague 'current reduced' criterion must check 130 °C and 15 A.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Over a 10 s recording, WLC_Status period is 50 ms ± 5 ms; all four signals (window position, movement state, normalization state, fault state) are present. Repeat under worst-case bus load, including a diagnostic session.
tests.reason: The period requirement halves to 50 ms ± 5 ms, and LL-2024-09 requires the worst-bus-load check at the shorter cycle.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Blocking the window and injecting 27 A for 100 ms: B1A02 is stored (WLC-030), the motor is stopped (WLC-037) and the fault state is set in WLC_Status (WLC-038). Add a negative case: 25 A or less, or above 25 A for less than 50 ms, stores no B1A02.
tests.reason: The criteria stay the same, but the stop and fault-state checks now trace to the new WLC-037 and WLC-038 instead of WLC-030, so add those traces and rerun.
WLC-033 ('user friendly') is deleted and this is its only trace, so the test verifies no requirement. It could be run as non-requirement feedback if the team wants.

added.pass_criteria: With B1A02 stored by injecting 27 A for 100 ms, the motor is stopped. Confirm the motor stays stopped for as long as the code remains stored. Add WLC-037 to the test's traces.
With B1A02 stored, the fault state signal in WLC_Status is set in the next WLC_Status frame (50 ms ± 5 ms period). Add WLC-038 to the test's traces.

added.extend_test: New test (suggest TC-AP-10). TC-AP-01 and TC-AP-08 could provide the setup.
added.pass_criteria: Trigger a pinch reversal. An express close command at about 1 s after the reversal is not executed. An express close command after 2 s from the reversal is executed. Repeat at 9.0 V and at 13.5 V. Check how this interacts with the repeated-pinch lockout (WLC-019) so the two do not conflict. WLC-039 gives no tolerance on the 2 s, so ask for one before fixing the test points close to 2 s.

concerns.concern: LL-2021-07: the threshold change from 100 N to 80 N needs a new check of both false reversals (vibration profile) and stop time. Rerun TC-AP-09 even though its requirement is deleted, and do not retire it.
LL-2022-02: cold plus low voltage is the worst case for stop time. With the lower threshold and longer reversal, run this corner first and on every software release.

They do not trace to a changed requirement but depend on the anti-pinch behaviour. TC-AP-06 (WLC-016) may quote the old thresholds; check and rerun it. The new WLC-012 requires anti-pinch active on a CAN close, while TC-AP-07 and WLC-017 turn it off when not normalized. Clarify what WLC_CloseAll does when the controller is not normalized, and add a test case.

WLC-012 drops the rain trigger. Confirm that removing automatic closing on rain is intended and that the body controller now owns it. If the rain function is still wanted, it needs its own requirement.
The new WLC-039 (2 s express-close inhibit) may overlap or conflict with the repeated-pinch lockout WLC-019. Review that test and its requirement together.

LL-2024-01: a limit check on an estimate must use a current estimate. Check that the shared thermal module fix for WLC-200 is present before TC-TH-02 is trusted. Also check whether the thresholds in TH-03 and TH-04 are consistent with the new 130 °C.
The 15 A current limit above 130 °C could lengthen the full close time (WLC-010) or affect pinch detection and stop time when hot. Check both under limiting.
LL-2024-09: when the cycle time shortens from 100 ms to 50 ms, repeat the worst-case queue calculation. Test the frames under the worst bus load, including diagnostic sessions.

B1A02 now drives the motor stop and fault state through WLC-037 and WLC-038. Check the response time (WLC-031) for the diagnostic reaction. LL-2023-05 also says the sensor-removal test must run at the lowest supply voltage; check that TC-DG-01 does.
The window now lasts 60 s, which also drives the TC-PW-04 current and power budget. Check that nothing else assumed 45 s.
It traces to WLC-035 only, but climatic operation includes anti-pinch at the new thresholds. Check whether it needs a rerun at the end of the program.
The software process requirement is deleted and has no test, so no test action is needed. Confirm the process evidence is still tracked outside the test set.

added.WLC-039: After a pinch reversal, express close shall be inhibited for 2 s.
added.WLC-037: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall stop the motor.
added.WLC-038: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.

deleted.WLC-018: The anti-pinch function shall be robust against all disturbances.
deleted.WLC-023: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s.
deleted.WLC-032: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
deleted.WLC-033: The controller shall be user friendly.
deleted.WLC-034: The software shall be developed according to the company software process.

WLC-007.old: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 45 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.
WLC-007.new: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.

WLC-012.old: The window shall close quickly when the rain sensor reports rain.
WLC-012.new: When the body controller sends the CAN request WLC_CloseAll, the controller shall close the window in express mode, with anti-pinch protection active.

WLC-014.old: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 100 N.
WLC-014.new: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N.

WLC-015.old: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 125 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
WLC-015.new: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.

WLC-021.old: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set itself to not normalized.
WLC-021.new: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set its state to not normalized.

WLC-025.old: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds the limit, the controller shall reduce motor current to a safe value.
WLC-025.new: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, the controller shall limit motor current to 15 A.

WLC-028.old: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 100 ms ± 10 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.
WLC-028.new: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 50 ms ± 5 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.

WLC-030.old: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms and shall stop the motor and shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.
WLC-030.new: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms.
